## Version and platform

Include the package version or commit, operating system, Python version and
compiler if you built the wheel locally.

## Reproduction

Include the CLI command or public API code, scenario, scenario version, agent,
seed and decision count. Include the first differing tick and StateHash when
available. A small trace can help if it contains only shareable synthetic data.

## Expected and observed behavior

Describe the difference. Indicate whether you reproduced it in a fresh process
on the same build and dependencies.

For a security report, use the private channel described in `SECURITY.md`.
